DOC0001.title: Tuberculosis
DOC0001.text: Tuberculosis is an infectious disease caused by bacteria that mainly affects the lungs. It spreads from person to person through the air.

DOC0002.title: High Blood Pressure
DOC0002.text: High blood pressure is a common condition where the force of blood against artery walls is too high. It can increase the risk of heart disease and stroke.

DOC0003.title: Diabetes Mellitus
DOC0003.text: Diabetes mellitus is a chronic metabolic disorder characterized by elevated blood glucose levels caused by problems with insulin production or action.

DOC0004.title: Influenza
DOC0004.text: Influenza is a respiratory illness caused by influenza viruses. Symptoms may include fever, cough, sore throat, and fatigue.

DOC0005.title: Heart Disease
DOC0005.text: Heart disease refers to several conditions affecting the heart. Coronary artery disease is one of the most common forms.
